messages:
incident-bot: [pager] high error rate for tenant 'wyvern' on dedicated VPC pool (tool-call parse errors, ~90% 5xx) — paging oncall
Sam H: oncall here, pulling logs now. tagging @maya and @carlos.
Maya K: I see repeated JSON parse failures in the runtime logs, sample: 
```
2026-03-15T08:12:09Z ERROR runtime.toolcall parser.js: UnexpectedTokenError at pos 234
raw_tool_response: '{"name":"charge","args":{"amount":100,},"meta":{}}'
```
note the trailing comma in args — tool/library emitted slightly different serialization.
Carlos P: we deployed a micro-optimization yesterday that touched the funcall serializer (2.3.1-quant). could be producing a trailing comma in edge cases. rolling back serializer would be possible but impacts other tenants.
Joel R: taking first handoff. what's customer impact and scope?
Emily S: Wyvern (enterprise, dedicated VPC, reserved pool) reports checkout failures in prod — they surface as immediate 5xx to end users, multiple merchants impacted. CS escalated to severity P1.
Priya S: prioritize tenant isolation and quick mitigation. Options: 1) route wyvern to a stable model/variant that doesn't hit the bug, 2) enable a lenient parser shim on the dedicated pool, or 3) perform a targeted rollback of the serializer on the pool. Recommend 1 + 2 for fastest recovery.
Sam H: agree. I'll create a routing rule to redirect wyvern traffic to redwood-2.1-stable. executing: 
```sh
# runbook command (platform-admin)
platform route set --tenant wyvern --pool dedicated-eu-1 --model redwood-2.1-stable --force
```
deploy-bot: Request accepted. Applying route change to dedicated-eu-1.
deploy-bot: Route change applied (12s). wyvern -> redwood-2.1-stable at 100%.
Maya K: logs show immediate drop in parser failures but still ~3% remaining errors coming from older cached workers with eager-json parser. I'll push a shim to those hosts: set `tool_response.allow_trailing_commas=true` at runtime.
Carlos P: can hotpatch the dedicated pool nodes to enable the shim without full restart. I'll coordinate with infra to run the patch job.
Carlos P: running hotpatch job: `infra hotpatch --pool dedicated-eu-1 --patch allow_trailing_commas=true` 
infra-bot: hotpatch job started (job id hp-8745).
Maya K: monitoring — errors dropping to ~0.8% in last 2m. Wyvern engineering confirms checkout flows are succeeding.
Emily S: drafting customer note: "We identified a parser regression caused by a recent runtime serializer optimization. We have routed your traffic to a stable variant and applied a temporary parser shim. No data loss. We'll follow up with a postmortem and a permanent fix." Sending to Wyvern CSM for approval now.
Priya S: good. please save all logs (/var/log/runtime/toolcall/*.log) and tag them with incident id wyvern-2056789123. we'll include them in the postmortem. Also include the serializer release notes for 2.3.1-quant.
Sam H: incident impact: initial 90% failure -> mitigated to <1% after route+shim. marking as mitigated. handoff to @priya for postmortem and long-term remediation (either revert serializer or harden serializer/serializer tests).
Joel R: I'll remain on-call for 30m to watch the customer and phone channel. If anything spikes, page me.
Priya S: I'll own the RCA and remediation plan. immediate actions: 1) revert or patch serializer for dedicated pools 2) add parser-fuzz tests for trailing commas 3) improve canary rules for serializer releases to dedicated pools 4) customer comms follow-up (Emily).
Emily S: Wyvern CSM acknowledged customer message and asked to be notified once we have timeline for permanent fix.
Sam H: closing notes: created incident ticket INC-2056789123, attached logs and hotpatch job output. will update ticket with postmortem link when ready. closing this thread in #eng-oncall; moving follow-up to #incidents for RCA scheduling. :thumbsup:
Joel R: thanks team — great quick coordination.
Priya S: adding postmortem owners and scheduling 1hr RCA for tomorrow.
incident-bot: incident INC-2056789123 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Sam H: thread closed (unless further regressions).
